title: ElectroCom61 benchmark: a dataset audit, a corrected partition, and a controlled detector benchmark

creators.name: Naji, Diyar Walaa
creators.affiliation: University of Technology - Iraq, Baghdad, Iraq

description: Code, data and run records for an audit of the ElectroCom61 object detection dataset, a corrected train/validation/test partition released as a manifest, and a controlled benchmark of five detectors on both partitions. Includes the split manifest, the verification scripts, per-run records, and the scripts that generate every figure and table in the accompanying paper.
